content: This paper presents a new method for simultaneously selecting important features and classifying functional data with categorical outcomes, particularly useful for longitudinal healthcare data from sources like wearable devices. The approach combines logistic loss with functional principal components and uses an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm to efficiently handle high-dimensional data, with effectiveness demonstrated through simulations and real-world analysis of chronic disease relationships.
